message.seaofsteves.assembled: Ship assembled: %s blocks, %s masts, %s sails. W/S sails, A/D helm, arrows trim, R to drop anchor.
message.seaofsteves.touching_land: Can't set sail: the ship is touching land at %s %s %s.
message.seaofsteves.too_big: Can't set sail: more than %s blocks. Is the ship touching land or the sea floor?
message.seaofsteves.no_sail: Can't set sail: the ship needs a mast. Stack %s or more fences and put a rectangle of Sails on top.
message.seaofsteves.block_entity: Can't set sail: %s can't be carried by ships yet.
message.seaofsteves.not_on_water: Can't set sail: the ship must be floating on water.
message.seaofsteves.too_fast: Slow down before dropping anchor (reef the sails with S).
message.seaofsteves.no_room: No room to drop anchor here: blocked at %s %s %s.
message.seaofsteves.anchored: Anchor dropped. Your ship is blocks again.
message.seaofsteves.rig.no_mast: Can't set sail: the Sail at %s %s %s isn't on a mast. Sails must sit on top of a stack of %s+ fences.
message.seaofsteves.rig.mast_too_short: Can't set sail: the mast under %s %s %s is too short. Stack at least %s fences.
message.seaofsteves.rig.sail_not_flat: Can't set sail: the sail at %s %s %s must be flat (one block thick).
message.seaofsteves.rig.sail_not_rectang: Can't set sail: the sail at %s %s %s must be a filled rectangle.
message.seaofsteves.rig.sail_not_on_mast: Can't set sail: the sail at %s %s %s must rest on top of its mast.
